name: India
overview: Scripture identifies India as the eastern boundary of King Ahasuerus' vast empire, stretching from India to Ethiopia, encompassing 127 provinces as described in Esther 1:1 and Esther 8:9. This geographical detail highlights the extensive reach of God's providence in history. Additionally, the call to worship the Lord from all the earth (Psalms 96:1) and the mandate to preach the gospel to all nations (Matthew 24:14) affirm that the message of Christ extends even to distant lands such as India, underscoring the global scope of the kingdom of God.
